subject: Does Mesh Affect  Correlation Values of Validation Model

messages.author: 96e275f43eafb053
messages.subject: Does Mesh Affect  Correlation Values of Validation Model
parts:
Hi All,

My validation models usually have weak  correlations . Could this be caused by the Mesh size or what factors affect correlation in a spatial temporal model fitted using INLA

Thanks.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Does Mesh Affect  Correlation Values of Validation Model
parts:
On 07/04/14 09:40, K.e wrote:
> My validation models usually have weak correlations .

Do you mean that the estimated spatial or temporal correlation range is
small? Or something else? What do you mean by "validation model"?

> Could this be
> caused by the Mesh size or what factors affect correlation in a spatial
> temporal model fitted using INLA

The main influence should be what correlations are actually there in the
input data (which is unrelated to the estimation method). From the
computational INLA point of view, too coarse meshes can also cause
issues. Hard to say anything more general than that.

Finn L
